title: mymkdir -p
summary: Create every missing directory of a path: mkdir for each prefix, and what to do when one already exists.
hints: Go through the path and, at every `/` (after the first character), cut the string there temporarily (`path[i] = '\0'`), call `mkdir` on that prefix and restore the `/`. Then create the whole path.
`mkdir` fails with `EEXIST` for something that already exists: that is fine for a directory (test with `opendir`) but an error for a file; in that case report `ENOTDIR`.
